objects.name: Analytic 2286
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies ICS protocol responses whose timing or payload structure deviates from the established device-specific per-function baseline in a pattern consistent with an intercepting relay or hook. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
